description.value: The Ramada by Wyndham Creston is a branded chain hotel situated on Highway 3A on the edge of Creston in the Kootenay region of BC. It sits along a major touring route connecting the Crowsnest Pass corridor with the Kootenay Lake ferry, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling east-west through the valley. As a full-service hotel it offers the standard amenities expected of the Ramada brand.
